description: This file defines classes and functions for database connection management and query handling using PEAR::DB in PHP, including connection encapsulation, record operations, and result set iteration.

classes.name: PearConnection
classes.description: Encapsulates a PEAR::DB database connection with lazy connection capability and error handling.

classes.name: PearRecord
classes.description: Represents a database record with methods for insert, update, and retrieving affected rows.

classes.name: PearRecordSet
classes.description: Handles result sets from database queries, supporting iteration, pagination, and total count retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with configuration or connection object.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the database connection object, establishing it if necessary.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using configuration parameters.

methods.name: makeLiteral
methods.description: Converts PHP values to SQL literals based on type.

methods.name: NewRecord
methods.description: Creates a new record object, optionally initialized with a DataSpace.

methods.name: NewRecordSet
methods.description: Creates a new record set for a query, with optional filtering.

methods.name: NewPagedRecordSet
methods.description: Creates a paged record set for a query.

methods.name: FindRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a single record based on a query.

methods.name: getOneValue
methods.description: Retrieves a single value from a query.

methods.name: getOneColumnArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of first-column values from a query.

methods.name: getTwoColumnArray
methods.description: Retrieves an associative array from a query with first column as key and second as value.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL query that does not return a cursor.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Internal method to execute a SQL query and handle errors.
